title: Select RealTmux in bee herding run from herding.transport
action: Wire the switch at run's single construction site. In `pub(super) fn run(flags: &[&str]) -> ExitCode` (run.rs:2530; the call is `let result = execute(&opts, &RealHerdr);` at 2538): after `parse_options` succeeds, call `crate::herding::transport_kind_at(&opts.main_root)` (tht-1). On Err print `bee herding run: <msg>` to stderr and return FAILURE before any split or mailbox write. On Ok build the transport into a local `Box<dyn PaneTransport>`: Herdr → `Box::new(RealHerdr)`, Tmux → load `<main_root>/.bee/config.json` (the same read `execute` does at run.rs:1917 — reuse or extract that helper) and `Box::new(RealTmux::new(TmuxSettings::from_config(&cfg)))`; then `execute(&opts, transport.as_ref())`. Pull the selection into a pure, testable `fn select_transport(kind: TransportKind, cfg: &Value) -> Box<dyn PaneTransport>` and test it: Herdr kind yields a RealHerdr (assert via a `fn name(&self) -> &'static str` you add to the trait with a default impl returning "herdr", overridden to "tmux" in RealTmux — the one permitted trait addition, default-implemented so the three test fakes need no edit), Tmux kind yields "tmux", and an invalid key refuses before execute (test `run` through the existing test harness pattern in run.rs's tests — see `test_options` at run.rs:3568 — with a config.json carrying `herding.transport: "nope"`). Also, under `--dry-run` the emitted JSON gains one additive key `transport` ("herdr"|"tmux") so an operator can see which transport would be used.

truths: With herding.transport=tmux, bee herding run constructs RealTmux and never spawns herdr
With the key absent, bee herding run behaves byte-identically (RealHerdr)
With an invalid value the run refuses before any pane split or mailbox write

checks.name: With herding.transport tmux bee herding run constructs RealTmux and never spawns herdr
checks.evidence: run.rs:2487-2492 select_transport maps TransportKind::Tmux to RealTmux::new(TmuxSettings::from_config(cfg)) and nothing else; run.rs:2585-2593 run() builds it before execute and passes transport.as_ref(). Live dry-run against a temp main-root with config herding.transport=tmux printed transport:tmux in the JSON; unit herding::run::tests::transport_select_tmux_kind_builds_the_tmux_transport.

checks.name: With the key absent bee herding run behaves as before (RealHerdr)
checks.evidence: transport_kind_at returns Herdr for an absent key and select_transport returns Box::new(RealHerdr) at run.rs:2489. Live dry-run with an empty config printed transport:herdr. The only edit inside execute_new is the extraction of read_main_config (run.rs:2478-2481), byte-equivalent to the inline read it replaced: read_to_string.ok().and_then(parse).unwrap_or(Null).

checks.name: An illegal value refuses before any pane split or mailbox write
checks.evidence: run.rs:2585-2591 the transport_for_run match returns FAILURE before execute is ever called. Live run with herding.transport=nope printed on stderr: bee herding run: herding.transport is nope - the only legal values are herdr and tmux, exit=1, and the temp main-root still held only .bee/config.json - no mailbox tree, no job file. Unit herding::run::tests::transport_select_run_refuses_an_illegal_value_before_any_split asserts the same two absences.

checks.name: No change to execute behavior for the herdr arm
checks.evidence: Commit 9ee96215 touches execute only at the config-read extraction; emit_result gained a transport parameter used only inside the RunOutcome::DryRun arm (run.rs:2545), so every non-dry-run herdr JSON is byte-identical. The trait gained one defaulted method name() returning herdr (run.rs:503-509).
